purpose: Required deterministic-check layer for AP Biology FRQ grading, offloading mechanical and structurally-checkable criteria from the language-model grader. Runs independently of the model and is not marked verified by it. See docs/architecture/CONTENT_AUTHORING_AND_PROMPT_ARCHITECTURE.md sections 7.1 and 7.2.
required_checks: required-field presence (each expected criterion has a decision and an evidence quote)
internal-contradiction check (an otherwise-earning claim voided by a contradicting statement elsewhere in the response)
misattribution / over-credit dependency-parse check for randomness-and-mechanism prose (adapted from the FRQ02-C2 checker in grader_speed_sp1_report.md)
calculation, unit, and rounding checks where a criterion is quantitative (Hardy-Weinberg, rates, ratios, probabilities)
abstention gate (unreadable input or missing required evidence returns unable_to_determine rather than a guessed score)
grader_signals: evidence quote drawn from the learner response
numeric answer and units where applicable
boundary-case rationale referencing the criterion-boundary contract
initial_calibration_targets: near-boundary earned (worked positive from the boundary contract)
near-boundary not_earned (worked negative from the boundary contract)
known_hard_cases: S020 — graded the same way by every model/effort/routing combination tested; treat as a Learning Quality label/rubric adjudication case, not a grader-capability gap (see grading_cross_subject_takeaways.md Lesson 5)
notes: The deterministic layer owns the mechanical criteria it can decide and offloads them from the model; it does not replace the language-model grader for judgment criteria.

This check set catches the confidently-wrong-but-complete and over-credit-by-misattribution error classes that model self-reported confidence structurally cannot (grading_cross_subject_takeaways.md Lessons 3-4).
Every deterministic check is version-pinned to the grading result alongside the prompt, model, and criterion-boundary contract.
The dependency-parse misattribution checker had two real bugs found and fixed during its own development; re-validate it against any new corpus before relying on it for real scores.
blocked_until: adjudicated AP Biology gold-set calibration review (dual-blind, per CONTENT_GOVERNANCE_AND_VALIDATION.md section 12)
subject readiness approval by the Product Owner
